name: Start page lists five assessments with metadata and actions
description: The Start page server-renders a hero heading and a grid of exactly five assessment cards (Solstice, Turing, Pride, Passage, and the Full Arc), each showing its short name, duration, question count, a 'Learn more' link, and a 'Start' button.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Start page at /start
Verify the page hero heading reads exactly 'Pick an assessment to start with.' — this confirms the browser is on the Start page and not the Home page.

Verify exactly five assessment cards are shown below the hero. The five short names are Solstice, Turing, Pride, Passage, and Full Arc, one per card. Each card must have a meta line containing both a duration ending in 'min' and a question count containing the word 'questions'. Every card must also have a 'Learn more' link and a 'Start' button.
